thread.title: Parks and Recreation Commission announces agenda for April 9 meeting
thread.title_full: Parks and Recreation Commission announces agenda for April 9 meeting

author: t. s. hildebrand
title: Parks and Recreation Commission announces agenda for April 9 meeting
text:
The Village of Hastings-on-Hudson Parks and Recreation Commission announced on April 8 the agenda for its upcoming regular meeting, which will take place at the James Harmon Community Center on April 9 at 7 p.m.
The meeting will provide an opportunity for public comment and address both old and new business related to local parks and recreation. The commission is set to review updates on Hillside Courts and Hillside Woods, as well as approve the minutes from its March meeting.
New business topics include discussions about new or upcoming programs, Zinsser Gardens, a proposal regarding Rivertown Bike, a superintendent report, and a liaison report from the Conservation Commission. Residents interested in these issues are encouraged to attend or contact recreation@hohny.gov for more information.
Meetings like this allow community members to stay informed about ongoing projects in local parks and recreational spaces. According to the official village website, additional details about agendas and village initiatives can be found at http://hohny.gov .
The commission plans to adjourn after completing all items on the agenda.
